linesEn: Compression first, breakthrough only if earned
Stays openly symbolic, names no result
linesZh: 木星巨蟹座对冲摩羯象征轴线

linesEn: Treats past titles as planetary credit
Assumes Jupiter in Cancer simply favors Spain
Ignores the opposition routing growth through tension
linesZh: 把过往冠军当作行星层面信用
假定木星巨蟹直接利好西班牙
忽略对冲把成长导向张力

linesEn: Needs a verified RFEF founding time
Would weigh Moon, Ascendant, and houses
Less reliable when founding time is uncertain
linesZh: 需要经核验的足协奠基时间
会权衡月亮、上升与宫位
奠基时间不确定时反而更不可靠
